conceptions.note: A:E100 names irony and the ideal of beauty; these sentences name neither irony nor the ideal specifically as an ideal of beauty. They name the ideal and distinguish pathetic and playful satire.

thesis.ru: Сатирический поэт делает своим предметом удаление от природы и противоречие действительности с идеалом.
thesis.en: The satirical poet makes the distance from nature and the contradiction between reality and the ideal his subject.

conceptions.note: A:E100 names irony and the ideal of beauty; these sentences name neither irony nor the ideal specifically as an ideal of beauty. They name the ideal and distinguish pathetic and playful satire.

thesis.ru: Поэт представляет свой предмет серьёзно и с аффектом в карающей, или патетической, сатире; шутливо и с весёлостью — в шутливой сатире.
thesis.en: The poet presents his subject seriously and with affect in punitive or pathetic satire, and playfully and with cheerfulness in playful satire.

thesis.ru: В сатире действительность как недостаток противопоставляется идеалу как высшей реальности.
thesis.en: In satire reality as deficiency is set against the ideal as the highest reality.

left.reason: Page 12 sets reality against the ideal as the highest reality; it does not identify this ideal as the ideal of beauty, the target A:C020 of the register link.
